findings.title: Public SSH access
findings.description: TCP port 22 is reachable from the public internet.
findings.recommendation: Restrict the rule to approved networks or use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager where appropriate.

findings.title: IAM console user without MFA
findings.description: The IAM user has console access but no MFA device was found.
findings.recommendation: Enable MFA and review whether console access is still necessary.

findings.title: Unattached EBS volume
findings.description: The 80 GiB volume is not attached to an EC2 instance and may be generating avoidable cost.
findings.recommendation: Verify ownership and retention needs. Create a snapshot before deleting an unused volume.
